【云南菌子季·第3集 鸡枞菌】有一种菌，人怎么都种不出来，得靠蚂蚁。鸡枞被称为"菌中之王"，只长在白蚁的巢上——白蚁筑巢时养出菌丝，巢里恒温、恒湿，菌和蚁谁也离不开谁。正因这层共生，鸡枞千百年来难以大规模人工栽培，直到2024年5月，昆明才在人工白蚁巢里长出第一朵。它有多鲜？一口下去鲜掉眉毛；吃不完，云南人就把它熬成能存很久的油鸡枞。

Ep.3 Termite mushroom (jicong). One mushroom people simply cannot grow — ants do. Jicong, the "king of mushrooms," fruits only on termite nests: the termites farm its mycelium in a warm, humid mound, each depending on the other. Because of that symbiosis it resisted large-scale cultivation for centuries — until May 2024, when Kunming coaxed the first fruit from an artificial termite nest. Impossibly savory fresh; leftovers become long-keeping oil-preserved jicong.

AI-assisted edit; the bilingual subtitles are the narration — no voiceover. Facts checked this run; sources below. Food culture & safety note, not medical or dietary advice. Footage licensed from Pexels (credited below).
